name: You Are My Treasure
source:
The year is 1720, the War of Spanish Succession has just ended and now the European Powers operating in the Caribbean are looking to eliminate the pirates that have taken advantage of the unrest to make a pretty penny for themselves. Captain Carmen “Cards” Rodriguez and her crew of buccaneers have fallen prey to such efforts and after a terrible battle against two Royal Navy Frigates, the Pirate Captain has found herself with neither crew nor ship. Through her wits and cunning she has eked her way to the Pirate hub of Nassau and learns of an opportunity that will help her turn her life around.

Will this be her chance to score big and gain the booty that all pirates dream of?
What capers and adventures will she go on along the way?
Will she survive this perilous voyage or will her wit and charm help her survive?
Might she even meet the woman of her dreams along the way?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1720年，西班牙王位继承战争刚刚结束，现在在加勒比地区活动的欧洲列强正在寻求消灭那些利用动乱为自己谋取大笔利益的海盗。卡门·“卡兹”·罗德里格斯船长和她的海盗船员们都成为了这种努力的牺牲品，在与两艘皇家海军护卫舰进行了一场可怕的战斗后，海盗船长发现自己既没有船员也没有船。凭借她的智慧和狡猾，她艰难地到达了拿骚的海盗中心，并得知了一个可以帮助她扭转生活的机会。

这会是她大获全胜并获得所有海盗梦寐以求的战利品的机会吗？
一路上她又会经历怎样的精彩和冒险呢？
她会在这次危险的航行中幸存下来，还是她的智慧和魅力会帮助她生存？
一路上她是否会遇到她的梦中情人呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921520/]Steam[/url]]
